note: Five enemy tiers. Conscript, regular and veteran are defined here; elite is the Writ officers (writ.json) and boss is the Provost and Orrick. Every tier has a hollow_<tier> variant built at world.hollowing.drone_percent: no morale, never breaks, keeps shooting after a hit.

conscript.name: Conscript
conscript.note: Bureau levies in borrowed kit. Act 1 fodder: poor aim, nervous.

regular.name: Regular
regular.note: Line troops. The Bureau's baseline soldier.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.note: Seasoned and steady; they use cover and range.

elite.name: Elite
elite.note: The Writ's officers, each with a hand-built stat block.

boss.name: Boss
boss.note: The Provost, and Orrick when he stands in the line.

hollow.note: A hollow variant of conscript, regular or veteran uses the tier's stats at the hollowing percentage; its id base is the tier's plus the offset (300, 310, 320).
